_README: General Chemistry for Engineers II (01:160:160) of the SoE first-year program, as its OWN component (Prompt 08 B1).

Not every major requires it, and which ones do depends on the class year. A major's curriculum version links this component only when the footnotes below say it applies - so the exception is explicit per curriculum, never a toggle on a universal tree.
